title: 150′ Luxury Motor Yacht Overview and Notability
description: 150ft (2010) luxury motor yacht - recently refitted, six-cabin layout, touch-and-go helicopter pad and sundeck jacuzzi.
html:
This 150 ft (45.72 m) Richmond motor yacht, built in 2010 and currently located in Barcelona, is notable for a blend of substantial range, helicopter touch-and-go capability and interior refinements that make her equally suited to private cruising or charter work. Her semi-displacement hull delivers a comfortable ride underway and at anchor, aided by zero-speed stabilizers, while a top speed of 18 knots and a long-range capability of approximately 3,500 nautical miles support extended passages. Recent major yard work, including a comprehensive refit and an ABS 10‑year class survey, keeps the vessel in exceptionally presentable condition for her size and age.

Six-Cabin Guest Layout and Elegant Interior Details

The yacht sleeps up to 12 guests across a flexible six-cabin arrangement, anchored by a full-beam, on‑deck master suite forward on the main deck with his-and-hers baths that provide privacy and expansive forward views. The warm mahogany joinery with a satin finish defines the salon and accommodation spaces, which benefit from new carpeting and wall coverings throughout; the main salon also received new soft goods and the sky lounge new furniture during recent refits. The open sky lounge functions as an entertainment hub with a full-service bar, game table, cinema setup and exterior dining for 12, while interior sightlines and natural light create a welcoming atmosphere for relaxed days at sea or formal evening gatherings.

Performance, Range and Recent Mechanical Upgrades

Under her semi-displacement hull she offers efficient cruising at about 14 knots and a maximum of 18 knots, with a shallow draft of roughly 7.33 ft that aids access to many Mediterranean anchorages. Mechanical reliability has been a priority: in November 2020 the yacht completed her 10‑year ABS class survey and underwent a $2M refit at LMC, which included roughly $1M of work in the engine room — engines and generators were rebuilt — plus new teak on the transom and high-traffic areas. The hydraulic systems for stabilizers and steering were updated in 2018, contributing to precise handling and comfort both underway and at rest.

Outdoor Living: Sundeck, Jacuzzi, Alfresco Dining

Outdoor spaces are designed for socializing and relaxation: a massive sundeck houses a full-service bar, an eight-person jacuzzi, a day head and a large flatscreen TV, while alfresco dining is available on every deck to accommodate varied moods from casual breakfasts to sunset dinners. The exterior layout lends itself to entertaining large parties or creating intimate moments; daytime can be spent lounging around the jacuzzi or sunbeds, and evenings transition easily to bar service and dining under the stars. The vessel is also rated for touch-and-go helicopter operations, adding flexibility for short transfers or scenic arrivals.

Crew Expertise, Refits, Surveys and Year-Round Care

An experienced, professional crew maintains the yacht to a “boat show” standard year-round, ensuring systems are kept current and presentation is impeccable for owners or charter guests. Major refit work in 2018 included a full exterior paint and soft-goods renewal in the main salon, and the 2020 LMC program addressed both cosmetic and mechanical priorities culminating in the successful ABS 10‑year survey. Regular preventative maintenance and attentive onboard service make this vessel turnkey for immediate operation, whether for longer cruising seasons or commercial charter deployment.

Recap of Key Specifications and Next Steps to Explore

In short, this 150 ft (45.72 m) motor yacht from 2010 offers six cabins for up to 12 guests, a full-beam on-deck master, zero-speed stabilizers, a top speed of 18 knots with a comfortable 14-knot cruising speed, roughly 3,500 nm range, helicopter touch-and-go capability and comprehensive refits and surveys completed in recent years — all maintained by an experienced crew and currently based in Barcelona. For prospective buyers or charter operators, viewing in person will best convey the scale of her decks and the quality of finish; please contact us to request additional images, technical documents or to arrange a private tour.

For more information on this yacht including additional pictures and brochures, or to schedule a tour, please contact us below. While efforts have been made to ensure accuracy, readers are encouraged to verify details independently.
